steps.text: Head into Canifis and do the Canifis Rooftop Course until 50 Agility. — Do not stay at the Canifis course past level 50, it isn't worth the slower xp. — You can wield the Wolfbane dagger to prevent yourself from attacking someone and making them a werewolf.
steps.note: Wilderness Agility Course - fastest here (deep Wilderness, keep risk low and watch for PKers).

steps.title: Do Agility Pyramid until you reach …
steps.text: Do Agility Pyramid until you reach 70 Agility. — When you need supplies walk to Nardah, take the carpet to Pollnivneach, buy waterskins from the general store, and wines in the bar. Adjust your waterskin/wine ratio as you level up. You can fill the waterskins to 4 at the fountain in the middle of town. — Another option is simply buying choc-ice from Rokuh in Nardah, which weigh almost nothing and serve as both food and water.
steps.note: Hallowed Sepulchre (needs Sins of the Father) for fastest XP + profit; rooftop courses if you still need graceful.
